title: Randomized PVP
description: This datapack randomly switches PvP on and off at unpredictable times. When enabled, players can fight; when disabled, they’re immune to direct damage from players.
body:
# Randomized PVP

Tired of predictable PVP battles? This datapack turns combat into a thrilling game of chance by randomly enabling and disabling PVP at unexpected moments. One minute you're locked in fierce battle - the next, all attacks are blocked as an uneasy truce takes hold.

## Key Features:
**• Unpredictable Combat** - PVP toggles on/off automatically at random intervals

**• Clear Notifications** - Server-wide alerts when PVP status changes

**• PVP-Only Mode** - Players can't deal damage when PVP is disabled

**• Multiplayer Ready** - Perfect for servers and minigames

**• Configurable Timing** - Adjust frequency in the config files


The rules keep changing - will you attack while you can or wait for the perfect moment? Includes a triggerable command to display current PVP status.
